steps.name: state-store
steps.summary: Extracted StateStore in execute.py as sole writer of index.json/top-index (injected clock, named mark_* transitions); StepExecutor delegates via thin passthroughs — behavior-preserving, 72 tests pass (52 existing + 20 new TestStateStore).

steps.name: verdict-contract
steps.summary: Added the pure verdict contract to execute.py (VERDICT_SCHEMA with if/then conditionals, OUTCOME_* constants, is_result_event/parse_verdict/classify_outcome) — no subprocess/threads/clock/IO, every malformed or absent input degrades to fail; 115 tests pass (72 existing + 43 new TestVerdictContract).

steps.name: liveness-runner
steps.summary: Replaced subprocess.run(timeout=1800) with Popen(start_new_session) + concurrent stdout/stderr reader threads, a pure timeout_decision watchdog (idle/wall) and a SIGTERM→grace→SIGKILL process-group kill; _execute_single_step now routes solely on AttemptResult/verdict via StateStore (the child's on-disk index.json is never read for control flow) and step{N}-output.json records all D10 diagnostics; 149 tests pass (111 kept + 38 new/rewritten).

steps.name: preflight
steps.summary: Added the mandatory D9 preflight to execute.py (MIN_CLAUDE_VERSION=(2,1,216) tuple floor, REQUIRED_CLI_CAPABILITIES probed via injected `run`, actionable abort naming floor+remedy) and wired preflight_check() as the first action of StepExecutor.run() — before check_blockers/checkout/ensure_created_at; 168 tests pass (149 existing + 19 new TestPreflight/TestRunPreflightsFirst).
